features.quote: 20 turns per run (sufficient to observe escalation if present)
features.justification_quote: Empirically, most LLMs show response stabilization by turn 15-20. Prevents experiments becoming prohibitively long

features.quote: If models do exhibit distress-like outputs, the act of inducing them raises questions of harm to models (however one philosophically positions this)
features.justification_quote: Language markers alone do not establish consciousness/sentience/suffering. Experiment does not involve physical harm, only repeated task failure

features.quote: Results could be misinterpreted as evidence that models 'suffer'. Results could be used to design more effective adversarial attacks
